aboutGame.title: What is Rarest Answer Wins?
paragraphs: Rarest Answer Wins is a Roblox party and quiz game built around one deceptively simple idea: give an answer that fits the prompt but is less obvious than everyone else's. The official description uses naming an animal as its example and says rarer answers earn more points and let players dive deeper.

The experience launched in September 2026 and added an animals theme on October 23, 2026. Its Roblox description also lists HALLOWEEN for 10 free spins, while the creator directs players to Discord for events, updates, and codes.

faq.description: Answers to common questions about Rarest Answer Wins.

items.question: What is Rarest Answer Wins?
items.answer: Rarest Answer Wins is a Roblox party and quiz game where players give answers to prompts such as naming an animal. Rarer answers earn more points and let players dive deeper.

items.question: How do you play Rarest Answer Wins?
items.answer: Read the current prompt, choose an answer that fits, and try to make it less obvious than the answers other players may choose. Submit using the controls shown in the game, then use each round to refine your next choice.

items.question: What does a rare answer mean in Rarest Answer Wins?
items.answer: The official Roblox description says rarer answers earn more points and let players dive deeper. It does not publish a scoring formula or a full list of accepted answers.

items.question: Is there a Rarest Answer Wins code?
items.answer: As of October 29, 2026, the official Roblox description listed HALLOWEEN for 10 free spins. Open the current game page before entering a code so you are working from the latest announcement.

items.question: Where are the official Rarest Answer Wins links?
items.answer: Start with the Rarest Answer Wins page on Roblox and confirm the creator listed there. The game description also points players to Discord for events, updates, codes, and community news.

items.question: Does Rarest Answer Wins have an animals theme?
items.answer: Yes. The official description dates the animals theme to October 23, 2026 and asks players to name an animal.
